session_summary: A medical session discussing Mrs. Georgescu's diabetes management, foot wound, and upcoming tests. The doctor referred her to surgery and outlined care instructions.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Surgery Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Get an appointment at the county hospital outpatient clinic
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will refer you to surgery, to the outpatient clinic of the county hospital. Try to get an appointment during the next week.

proposed_actions.title: Prepare Weekly Medication Box
proposed_actions.description: Ana to prepare a weekly pill box for Mrs. Georgescu
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Ana, please prepare it for the whole week on Sunday evening.

proposed_actions.title: Perform Daily Wound Care
proposed_actions.description: Daily dressing with physiological serum and betadine
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: The community assistant can come to your home to show you how to do it.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Lab Tests
proposed_actions.description: Hemoglobin A1c and urine test at the lab
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I also want a hemoglobin A1c and a urine test. Do those at the lab by Friday.

proposed_actions.title: Arrange Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Return on 20 November at 11:00 with results and medical letter
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Come back then on twenty November, at eleven o'clock, with the results and with the medical letter from the surgeon.

decisions: Referral to surgery for the foot wound
Schedule lab tests for hemoglobin A1c and urine test
Assign community assistant for wound care
risks: Risk of fever or foot swelling requiring immediate attention
Risk of forgetting diabetes tablets leading to high blood sugar
follow_up_questions: Is there a specific time the community assistant should arrive?
What is the exact procedure for the lab tests?
Is there a specific pharmacy for the medication box?
